messages:
Maya: Quick design check — compact chart row in the dashboard. Two things noticed: 1) legend items wrap awkwardly when we collapse the sidebar, 2) very tall outliers in the sparkline get clipped so the little mini-preview looks like a flat line. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.example/ux/mini-chart-clip.png

Derek: agree on clipping — the mini sparklines are giving a false negative signal when extreme spikes are truncated. Could we autoscale the sparkline preview independently from the full chart?

Lena: autoscaling helps for visibility but might make trend comparisons between rows harder. Suggestion: show a subtle spike marker (thin vertical line) when the full-range peak is outside the preview bounds, with a tooltip that shows the real peak value on hover.

Sam (Design): +1 to Lena's marker idea. Also we should avoid multiple-line legend wraps in the compact row — it pushes the mini-chart down and breaks alignment. Two options: (A) force a single-line truncated legend with an ellipsis and hover to expand, (B) collapse less-critical meta (units) into an icon that reveals on hover. Thoughts?

Theo (Eng): (A) is easy: CSS text-overflow + title tooltip. (B) needs a small interactive affordance and added keyboard focus targets. We can prototype (A) quickly and iterate.

Maya: I like (A) for a quick win. For accessibility we need the tooltip accessible via keyboard focus and screen reader — not just title attribute. Sam, can you propose the hover/focus behavior copy?

Sam (Design): Proposal for tooltip copy: "Series: request latency — peak 2.4s at 14:12 UTC — unit: p95 (ms)". For the ellipsis state, screen reader text should read the full series name plus a hint like "press Enter to reveal more details".

Derek: For the outlier marker, we should include a compact mini-popup with two lines: absolute peak and relative time. Example content: 
```
Peak: 2.4s (200% of median)
Time: 14:12 UTC
```
Keyboard: focus on the chart opens the same popup with Enter.

Maya: Nice. Accessibility nit — ensure the marker has a 3:1 contrast with background and that it’s reachable by keyboard without shifting focus order for other controls.

Theo (Eng): Implementation notes: we can use an SVG overlay for the sparkline preview with an extra <line> element for the marker. Will add aria-labelledby to the marker pointing at the popup content. Performance: negligible for ~50 rows; we should batch DOM updates during render.

ui-bot: reminder: design review checklist item added to PR #4227 — link: https://git.redwood/PR/4227

Lena: One more UI copy nit — unit abbreviation on the axis: current "ms" is fine but on tiny rows the axis label becomes ambiguous. Recommend we show unit only in the expanded modal and use a tooltip on unit icon in compact rows.

Sam (Design): Decision proposal: ship legend truncation (A) + accessible tooltip, add outlier marker + keyboard popup, and defer autoscaling to v2 after we measure confusion. I'll write the copy and the a11y spec.

Maya: Sounds good. Action items: Sam — a11y spec & tooltip copy; Theo — spike implementation prototype (SVG marker + aria) in a branch; Derek — add popup content example for engineering in the PR; Lena — validate copy in small-screen mock. Target: prototype by EOD Friday.

Theo (Eng): I’ll start the spike now and ping the thread when there’s a demo link.

Maya: Thanks team :thumbsup:
